jobs.title: Public Safety Officer (Guard), University Police
jobs.company: The University of Texas at San Antonio
jobs.description:
Location: San Antonio, TX

Regular/Temporary: Regular

Job ID: 15551

Full/Part Time: Full Time

Position Information The University of Texas at San Antonio (UT San Antonio) is a nationally recognized, top-tier public research university that unites the power of higher education, biomedical discovery and healthcare within one visionary institution. As the third-largest research university in Texas and a Carnegie R1-designated institution, UT San Antonio is a model of access and excellence - advancing knowledge, social mobility and public health across South Texas and beyond. UT San Antonio serves approximately 42,000 students in 320 academic programs spanning science, engineering, medicine, health, liberal arts, AI, cybersecurity, business, education and more.

With 17,000 faculty and staff, UT San Antonio has also been recognized as a Top Employer in Texas by Forbes Magazine. Learn more online, on UT San Antonio Today or on X, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube or LinkedIn.

Salary Range: $36,894 annualized, commensurate with education, experience, and qualifications.

Job Type: Full Time

Posting Close Date: Applications will be accepted through 11:59 PM CDT on 07/25/2026. At the discretion of the hiring department, this posting may close once a sufficient number of qualified applications have been received.

Required Application Materials

  • Resume is required

  • Cover Letter is preferred

    Job Details

    Job Summary The Public Safety Officer is responsible for providing security in the protection, safety and welfare of students, employees, visitors and property within the control and jurisdiction of a component institution of The University of Texas System; operates within the limits prescribed by the Rules and Regulations of the Board of Regents, institutional rules and regulations and departmental policies and procedures. Serves as a Campus Security Authority as defined by the Jeanne Clery Disclosure of Campus Security Policy and Campus Crime Statistics Act (Clery Act). Enforce the rules and regulations of the University of Texas System Administration pertaining to the safeguarding of students, employees, visitors, property, and buildings of the University of Texas at San Antonio.

    Core Responsibilities

    • Enforces the rules, regulations, policies and procedures of the University of Texas System and the University
    • Conducts regular patrols (on foot, golf cart, motor vehicle to include a truck, and by bicycle if certified) of both the main and downtown campuses.
    • Conducts guard tours of controlled spaces, patrols buildings, parking lots, and other UTSA controlled property to assists with asset protection, provide security presence and prevent crime.
    • Patrols buildings and grounds to check for fires, water leaks, and potential security and safety hazards. Investigates and reports abnormalities.
    • Assists with security surveys to look for safety and security deficiencies such as lighting, landscaping and safety concerns.
    • Inspects emergency phones and other security equipment.
    • Assists with emergency response and provides emergency assistance when needed
    • Provides security support for special events such as weddings, sporting events, concerts etc. by opening and closing facilities, conducting security sweeps, assigned fixed posts, bag checks, security camera surveillance etc.
    • Provides customer service to the public by providing security escorts, motorist assistance; provides information and direction to students, employees, and visitors; directs traffic.
    • Utilizes a handheld radio for communication to dispatch, supervisor and other Public Safety officers and Police.
    • Writes electronic reports; takes observational field notes.
    • Unlocks and secures buildings, classrooms in both public and non-public areas, reports issues regarding the function and maintenance of entries and exits to include doors, door locks and other security systems.
    • Responds to calls for service, alarms, and /or observed behaviors. Provides requested services in a timely manner and in accordance with policies and procedures.
    • Examines credentials of persons desiring to enter controlled areas.
    • Attends meetings and training.
    • Assist security service and police teams.
    • Performs other duties as assigned. Other duties to include, but not limited to, emergency recall and/or may be required to remain onsite or work extended hours during man-made or natural disasters and unusual occurrences on campus. Required Qualifications

    • High school graduate or equivalent.
    • One (1) year of demonstrated ability to uphold responsibilities, reliably meet commitments and expectations, and exhibit dependability and accountability through employment, volunteer work, or community involvement
    • Must have the physical and mental capabilities to properly carry out his or her responsibilities and duties as a guard of The University of Texas System Police.
    • Continued employment contingent upon completion of a required formal field training program and achievement of sufficient proficiency.
    • Valid Texas State Driver's License.

    • Must be eligible to work in secure and/or restricted-access facilities and demonstrate the ability to meet all compliance standards, including those mandated by grant funding agencies and site-specific security protocols.
    • Eyesight and hearing shall be of sufficient acuity to accomplish the job duties described.
    • This position requires the ability to maintain the security and integrity of UT San Antonio and its infrastructure per Texas EO-GA-48

      • Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Communication.
  • Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Familiarity and experience with Police Department equipment.
  • Sharp Acumen. Working Conditions

  • Work involves a high degree of hazard normally associated with law enforcement.
  • May be required to work either day or night on any one of three shifts with varying days off.
  • Exposure to outside weather conditions.
  • Must be flexible to work evenings, weekends and holidays.
  • Required walking and standing shall be done without the aid of canes, crutches or similar tools.

  • Public Safety Officers must be willing to work assigned shifts, which may include dayshift, evening shift, overnight midnight shifts and power shifts that cover the most populated times of the day at both Main campus and Downtown campus.
  • Public Safety Officers are assigned to work varying shifts based on seniority to cover the campus 24/7 and shift change periods.

    • Physical Demands

  • Must be able to walk, climb stairs, stand, sit, both inside and outside areas for extended periods of time.

    • This position will be located on the main and/or downtown campus. Must be flexible to work at either campus as needed. Travel and parking expenses are the employee's responsibility.

    This position is contingent upon a successful background check. Verification of a valid driver's license and Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) may be completed as applicable. Applicants selected must be able to show proof of eligibility to work in the United States by time of hire.

jobs.title: Security Officer Full Time - Reception
jobs.description:
Overview

Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

Job Description

As a Security Officer Full Time - Reception in San Antonio, TX, you will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Residential, and more. As a Front Desk Security Professional at a residential location, you will welcome residents and guests, manage access control, monitor activity, and provide outstanding customer service. You will serve as a visible, approachable presence, communicate clearly with residents and staff, and help address security-related concerns. Join Allied Universal’s caring, team-oriented culture, where integrity, reliability, and innovation guide the work we do.

Position Type: Full Time

 Pay Rate: $17.00 / Hour

Job Schedule

DayTimeMon12:00 AM - 08:00 AMTue12:00 AM - 08:00 AMWed12:00 AM - 08:00 AMThur12:00 AM - 08:00 AMFri12:00 AM - 08:00 AM

What You'll Do

  • Provide customer service to residents, visitors, and/or vendors at a residential front desk by carrying out site-specific procedures and security-related policies.
  • Monitor access to the property, greet and screen visitors, verify authorization as required, and maintain visitor and vendor logs.
  • Receive calls, deliveries, and resident inquiries; provide directions and communicate concerns to appropriate property personnel.
  • Respond to incidents, alarms, and critical situations in a calm, problem-solving manner, following emergency response procedures.
  • Monitor front desk activity and access control systems, document security-related observations, and report unusual activity to appropriate personnel.

Minimum Requirements

  • Comfortable using a computer or tablet is preferred.
  • CPR/First Aid certification is preferred.
  • Customer service experience is preferred.
  • A Guard Card/License is preferred.
  • Access control/badge experience is preferred.
  • Be at least 18 years of age for unarmed roles; 21+ years of age for armed roles.
  • Possess a high school diploma or equivalent.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a background investigation in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws.
  • Allied Universal will consider qualified applications with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable laws.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a drug screen to the extent permitted by law.
  • Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment.
  • A valid driver’s license will be required for driving positions only.

Why Join Us

  • Smart Tools: Access to our exclusive technology to view and claim additional shifts to earn more.
  • Career Growth: Get paid training and access to career growth opportunities.
  • Financial and Health Benefits: Enjoy access to a retirement savings plan, plus medical, dental, vision, basic life and AD&D, and disability insurance.
  • Exclusive Perks: Enjoy discounts on top brands and services through our Perks Program.

Closing

Allied Universal® is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, age, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status or relationship/association with a protected veteran, or any other basis or characteristic protected by law. For more information: www.aus.com.

If you have difficulty using the online system and require an alternate method to apply or require an accommodation, please contact our local Human Resources department. To find an office near you, please visit: www.aus.com/offices. C15802
